summary.text: 家 is written with 宀 above 豕. The upper element suggests a roof or dwelling; the lower element’s identity and role in the earliest forms are disputed. Early uses for dwelling and household are reported, and today 家 commonly means house, home, or family.

formation.text: The construction is disputed. In the traditional analysis, 宀 marks a dwelling and the lower element is understood as an abbreviated 豭, used for sound. Other analyses see a pig beneath a roof and propose an original sense such as ‘pig enclosure’; that proposed origin is not established. 家 and 豭 have matching readings in modern Mandarin and in one reconstruction system, which makes the sound analysis plausible if 豭 is the relevant element, but does not identify the earliest lower sign.

components.text: 宀 is the roof or dwelling element in the proposed construction. It appears as a full component; no separate earlier form is proposed.

The visible lower form is 豕. Some analyses see a pig contributing to a scene beneath a roof; the traditional analysis instead treats it as an abbreviated 豭 used for sound. 豭 is not established as a graphic ancestor or full form of 豕, and the proposed earlier sign 𢑓 and its alleged change into 豕 remain unverified.

sound_limitation.text: The comparisons show sound compatibility if 豭 is the relevant element; they do not establish the earliest lower sign’s identity or provide a reading for proposed sign 𢑓.

sound.text: The modern Mandarin readings match. This supports compatibility only if 豭 is the relevant element; it does not assign a reading to visible 豕.
家 and 豭 have the same reconstructed Middle Chinese form, kae, in this system, supporting phonetic compatibility if 豭 is the relevant element.
家 and 豭 have the same reconstructed Old Chinese form, *kˤra, in this system, supporting phonetic compatibility if 豭 is the relevant element.

history.text: The traditional written analysis identifies the lower form as an abbreviation of 豭 used for sound; the regular-script form writes 豕 beneath 宀. This traditional account does not show that 豕 developed graphically from 豭.
The claim that oracle-bone 𢑓 was the original lower sign and later changed into 豕 through graphic corruption remains unverified.

uncertainties.text: The earliest lower element’s identity and role are unsettled. Some analyses link it to 豭 as a sound element; others read a pig contributing to a meaningful scene and propose ‘pig enclosure’ as an original meaning. That proposed origin is not established.

Matching readings and reconstructions for 豭 and 家 do not establish that the earliest lower sign was named 豭. No independent ancient pronunciation for the proposed depicted animal or sign is established.

senses.period: Oracle-bone uses are reported; dates of individual examples are unresolved
senses.text: Early uses associated with dwelling are reported, including human dwelling in oracle-bone contexts. A pig-enclosure meaning has been proposed as an origin, but is not established as the earliest meaning.

senses.gloss: ancestral temple, family, royal house or household unit
senses.period: Oracle-bone and bronze uses are reported; sequence unresolved
senses.text: Reported uses include ancestral temple and family, royal house or court, and households counted as 家. Their order and relationships are not established.
家 commonly means house or home, and also family. How these current meanings connect to each reported early institutional use is not established.

developments.text: Dwelling and household or institutional uses are both reported early, but their sequence and any development from one to the other are not established.
Modern house, home, and family meanings are established, but the chronology and transitions linking them to early reported uses remain unclear.

limitations.text: The reported early uses do not provide a dated sequence of examined inscriptions. Individual examples and the chronology of meanings remain unresolved.

The pig-enclosure proposal connects a proposed early meaning to human dwelling; the traditional phonetic analysis instead explains the graph through sound. Neither account establishes a full chronology of the word’s meanings.

overview.text: 家 combines a roof or dwelling element with a lower form whose identity and role are disputed. Early uses for dwelling and household are reported; today it commonly means house, home, or family.

components.text: 宀 contributes the roof or dwelling idea in the proposed construction.
The lower form is 豕. It may depict a pig or represent 豭 as a sound element; this does not establish its earliest graphic history.

relationships.text: In the proposed construction, 宀 contributes the roof or dwelling category.
Some analyses interpret the lower element as a pig contributing to a scene of livestock kept beneath a roof.

The traditional analysis proposes that the visible lower form represents an abbreviated 豭 used for sound. Matching readings and reconstructions make this plausible, but do not settle the earliest sign’s identity or establish a graphic derivation.
